fusions.name: Powder Charge
fusions.desc: Fires a ball of packed powder that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it hits and bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Muzzle Flash
fusions.desc: A flash of flame bursts from you in a narrow cone, dealing 12 damage to everything within 3 tiles, stunning each for 0.8 seconds and setting it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Powder Smoke
fusions.desc: Veils you in powder smoke for 5 seconds, and you move 15% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Ricochet
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a spark ricochets to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
